<style data-resource-hub-navigation>

.resource-hub-nav {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: block;
  position: static;
  float: none;
  width: auto;
  max-width: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border: 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ccd8d1;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #f7f8f5;
  color: #172e2c;
  font: 400 14px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  text-align: left;
}
.resource-hub-nav .resource-hub-links {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px 8px;
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0;
}
.resource-hub-nav .resource-hub-link {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 36px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: transparent;
  color: #205c49;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.resource-hub-nav .resource-hub-link:hover,
.resource-hub-nav .resource-hub-link[aria-current="page"] {
  background: #e5ede7;
  color: #172e2c;
}
.resource-hub-nav .resource-hub-link:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #205c49;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: 1120px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px 40px;
  background: #f7f8f5;
  color: #172e2c;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index > .resource-hub-nav {
  margin: 0 -24px 28px;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index > h1 {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 36px);
  line-height: 1.25;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index > p {
  max-width: 76ch;
  margin: 16px 0;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index > p a,
.resource-hub-questions-index .resource-hub-course-grid a {
  color: #205c49;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index > p a:focus-visible,
.resource-hub-questions-index .resource-hub-course-grid a:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #205c49;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index > .resource-hub-course-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 270px), 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 28px 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index .resource-hub-course-grid > li {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 20px;
  border: 1px solid #ccd8d1;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #fff;
  color: #172e2c;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.resource-hub-questions-index .resource-hub-course-grid > li > a {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 650;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .resource-hub-nav { padding: 8px; }
  .resource-hub-nav .resource-hub-links { gap: 2px; }
  .resource-hub-nav .resource-hub-link { padding: 7px 8px; }
  .resource-hub-questions-index { padding: 0 16px 28px; }
  .resource-hub-questions-index > .resource-hub-nav { margin: 0 -16px 24px; }
}
@media print {
  .resource-hub-nav { display: none; }
  .resource-hub-questions-index > .resource-hub-course-grid { display: block; }
  .resource-hub-questions-index .resource-hub-course-grid > li {
    break-inside: avoid;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
}

</style>
<script data-hub-root="../../">
/* Resource hub navigation. Educational markup and original scripts remain untouched. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const script = document.currentScript;
  function mountNavigation() {
  if (!script || !document.body || document.querySelector('.resource-hub-nav')) return;
  const root = new URL(script.dataset.hubRoot || './', document.baseURI);
  const destinations = [
    ['Home', 'index.html'],
    ['Study guide', 'Complete_CS_Exit_Study_Guide.html'],
    ['Questions', 'Questions/Interactive_Study_Guides/index.html'],
    ['Outlines', 'Outlines/index.html'],
    ['How to study', 'index.html#how-to-study']
  ];
  const nav = document.createElement('nav');
  nav.className = 'resource-hub-nav';
  nav.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Study hub');
  const links = document.createElement('div');
  links.className = 'resource-hub-links';
  const current = new URL(window.location.href);
  for (const [label, path] of destinations) {
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    const target = new URL(path, root);
    link.className = 'resource-hub-link';
    link.setAttribute('href', (script.dataset.hubRoot || './') + path);
    link.textContent = label;
    if (!target.hash && target.pathname === current.pathname) {
      link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    }
    links.append(link);
  }
  nav.append(links);
  document.body.prepend(nav);
  // Only this simple index receives layout classes; retain every original node.
  if (script.dataset.resourceHubIndex === 'questions') {
    document.body.classList.add('resource-hub-questions-index');
    for (const child of document.body.children) {
      if (child.tagName === 'UL') child.classList.add('resource-hub-course-grid');
    }
  }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', mountNavigation, { once: true });
  else mountNavigation();
})();

</script>
<!-- RESOURCE-HUB-INTEGRATION:END -->

  const root = new URL(script.dataset.hubRoot || './', document.baseURI);
  const destinations = [
    ['Home', 'index.html'],

  nav.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Study hub');
  const links = document.createElement('div');
  links.className = 'resource-hub-links';
  const current = new URL(window.location.href);
  for (const [label, path] of destinations) {

    link.className = 'resource-hub-link';
    link.setAttribute('href', (script.dataset.hubRoot || './') + path);

      link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    }
    links.append(link);
  }

    document.body.classList.add('resource-hub-questions-index');
    for (const child of document.body.children) {
      if (child.tagName === 'UL') child.classList.add('resource-hub-course-grid');
    }
  }
  }
